name: RocketReach MCP
description: Search professional profiles and companies, look up contact emails and phone numbers, and verify email addresses from AI assistants over MCP, for prospecting and lead research.

skills.name: Search People
skills.description: Searches professional profiles by name, title, employer, location or skills and returns the matching RocketReach profiles.

skills.name: Search Companies
skills.description: Searches companies by name, domain, industry, size, funding or tech stack to build lists of target accounts.

skills.name: Look Up Contact
skills.description: Retrieves a person's emails and phone numbers by profile ID, email, LinkedIn URL or name and employer, using lookup credits.

skills.name: Look Up Company
skills.description: Retrieves full company details by domain, company ID, name, ticker or LinkedIn URL and adds the company to your list.

skills.name: Verify Email
skills.description: Verifies whether an email address can receive mail by checking its format, domain and mailbox, catch-all domains included.
